# POST /api/v1/admin/users/{username}/repos

Creates a repository on behalf of a user (admin only)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (token with AccessTokenScopeCategoryAdmin) · **ID:** `ep-112`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateRepoOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `name` | string | True | AlphaDashDot, MaxSize(100) |
| `description` | string | False | MaxSize(2048) |
| `private` | bool | False |  |
| `issue_labels` | string | False | MaxSize(255) |
| `auto_init` | bool | False |  |
| `template` | bool | False |  |
| `gitignores` | string | False |  |
| `license` | string | False | MaxSize(100) |
| `readme` | string | False | MaxSize(255) |
| `default_branch` | string | False | GitRefName, MaxSize(100) |
| `trust_model` | string | False | enum: default,collaborator,committer,collaboratorcommitter |
| `object_format_name` | string | False | MaxSize(6) |

## Response

**201** — Repository

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Repository ID |
| `name` | string | Repository name |
| `full_name` | string | Full name (owner/repo) |
| `owner` | User | Repository owner |

- **400** — Invalid readme template
- **403** — Permission denied
- **404** — User not found
- **409** — Repository with same name already exists
- **422** — Reserved name or invalid pattern

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| All endpoints require site admin privilege (reqSiteAdmin middleware) | authorization | User must be site admin |
| Readme template must exist when auto_init is true | validation | opt.AutoInit && len(opt.Readme) > 0 && !slices.Contains(repo_module.Readmes, opt.Readme) |
| Private flag is OR'd with setting.Repository.ForcePrivate | business_logic | Always during repo creation |

- **Invalid readme template** → repo.CreateUserRepo → 400
- **Repo already exists** → repo.CreateUserRepo → 409
- **Reserved name** → repo.CreateUserRepo → 422
